asset_spec.concept: A high-quality stylized wooden treasure chest with a curved separate lid, substantial dark metal bands, hinges, corner hardware, side handles, a front lock, softened manufactured edges, and useful pivots for opening.

design_brief.concept: A high-quality stylized wooden treasure chest with a curved separate lid, substantial dark metal bands, hinges, corner hardware, side handles, a front lock, softened manufactured edges, and useful pivots for opening.

parts.connection_strategy: Self-contained structural base. Sits on ground plane at z=0.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at world origin (0,0,0) at the base center.

parts.connection_strategy: Sits on top of chest_body with a 0.005 m clearance gap. Hinged at the back edge.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the center of the back top edge of the chest_body (y=0.6, z=1.0).

parts.connection_strategy: Overlaps and wraps flush around the lower front third of the chest_body. Fastened visually by rivets.
Overlaps and wraps flush around the lower back third of the chest_body. Fastened visually by rivets.
Wraps flush over the vertical edges of the chest_body. Overlaps the horizontal bands.
Wraps flush over the vertical edge. Overlaps horizontal bands.
Wraps flush over the vertical edge. Overlaps horizontal bands.
Wraps flush over the vertical edge. Overlaps horizontal bands.
Knuckle cylinder aligned with the lid pivot axis. One leaf plate overlaps the chest_body back top edge, the other overlaps the lid back bottom edge. Visible axle seam.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the center of the knuckle cylinder, aligned with the lid pivot.

parts.connection_strategy: Knuckle cylinder aligned with the lid pivot axis. One leaf plate overlaps the chest_body back top edge, the other overlaps the lid back bottom edge. Visible axle seam.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the center of the knuckle cylinder, aligned with the lid pivot.

parts.connection_strategy: Overlaps the front center of the chest_body, just below the lid seam. Fastened visually by rivets.
Attached to the front bottom edge of the lid. Loops over the lock_plate when closed. Visible hinge seam where it meets the lid.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the hinge point on the lid front bottom edge.

parts.connection_strategy: Anchor plates overlap the left side of the chest_body. Grip cylinder hangs freely with a visible clearance gap from the wood.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the center of the grip cylinder.

parts.connection_strategy: Anchor plates overlap the right side of the chest_body. Grip cylinder hangs freely with a visible clearance gap from the wood.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin at the center of the grip cylinder.

parts.connection_strategy: Overlaps the bottom left front corner of the chest_body. Fastened visually by rivets.
Overlaps the bottom right front corner. Fastened visually by rivets.
Overlaps the bottom left back corner. Fastened visually by rivets.
Overlaps the bottom right back corner. Fastened visually by rivets.
Embedded flush into the surface of the metal hardware parts.
